name: 文章と診断添付を備えたフィードバックフォーム
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0047. Image1 ORIGINAL source is authority for icon geometry and fine control anatomy. Image2 is the previous generated edit target. Image3 is secondary mock for locked Japanese typography and content. Official pure-white/forest-green/slate design remains binding.
Edit prior LH07-0047 correcting typography and thumbnail borders only. All Japanese wording, selected2attachmentchecks, empty consentcheckbox, white surfaces, original screenshot photo/feed/sharemenu and loglineart retained. Every text run is Meiryo REGULAR, never semibold/bold: inputguide ご意見をお聞かせください。機密情報は入力しないでください。質問やサポートが必要な場合はヘルプをご利用ください。 AND cardtitles スクリーンショット / システムログ use identical14px/24px size/weight. Guide must be same readable glyphheight as cardtitles and wrap3lines at358px width, not2smalllines. Attachment actions 情報を隠す・強調する and 内容を確認 use12px/16px REGULAR forestgreen. Consent追加の情報について連絡する場合があります and full footer note use12px/16px REGULAR, withプライバシーの説明 and利用規約 greenunderlined. Do not bold any links. Keep compactcards60high,20pxselectedcircles and8pxgaps. Borderless inputtotal180high including3lineguide and modestblanktypingspace, no large additionalwhitespace. Remove invented extra framed rounded container around boththumbnailimages; screenshot/logthumbnail should be plain rectangles like original. No other changes or new copy/actions. Keep wholeform compact390x400 proportions and cropclose.
reviewNotes: 補助文字の太字と見本丸枠は改善。案内は同程度の14pxに戻ったが不自然な改段落で4行になり、入力の空白領域がほぼ消失。次は案内の連続3行と入力全高180だけを限定修正。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
